metadata.title: These Stocks Have the Muscle to Power AI. They’re Worth Another Look.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
These Stocks Have the Muscle to Power AI. They’re Worth Another Look.
The AI building spree has been a bonanza for construction companies. For their shareholders, it’s looked more like a bloodbath lately.
